messages:
jess: Quick check — I flipped kv-cache LRU -> LFU in canary (canary-42). Seeing a p99 jump on several hosts, need a quick go/no-go for rollout to prod.

mohit: Which model/seq/batch and job id? paste the perf command if you can.

jess: canary job: `canary-42`. model `rw-instruct-13b`, seq=512, batch=4. Run used: `./perf_run --job canary-42 --samples 2000`

infra-bot: Perf probe started for `canary-42` (job id 4321).

lina: Pulled the dashboard: p50=120ms, p95=210ms, p99=520ms. Error rate 0.05%. Notable: eviction churn on small-memory hosts.

ryan: Is this across all zones or specific hosts? diff between NVCache on/off?

lina: Mostly on A100-40 hosts with limited GPU mem. NVCache-off hosts are stable. Quick dump:
```
host-gpu-7: p99=520ms, evictions=124/s
host-gpu-2: p99=435ms, evictions=18/s
```

cassie: What are our rollback criteria again? I recall a p99 threshold and a pct regression rule.

mohit: Operational criteria we agreed on: p99 <= 450ms OR regression <= 10% vs baseline. Error rate must remain <0.2%. Anything outside => rollback.

jess: Baseline p99 for this workload is 420ms. Canary p99=520ms -> ~24% regression. I'm leaning rollback.

cassie: :thumbsup: Please trigger rollback and open an investigation ticket for LFU eviction hotspots.

infra-bot: Rollback initiated for `canary-42` -> kv-cache=v1. Rolling across affected hosts.

jess: Rollback finished. Canary p99 back to ~425ms, error rate unchanged. I'll attach profiling dumps and a reproducer.

ryan: Please post traces + reproducer link here and tag @perf-team.

jess: Created PERF-987 for follow-up: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PERF-987 — will add logs/traces there.

infra-bot: Canary job closed: result=rollback (go=no). Notifying @perf-team.
